problem: 4 - Add the MCP server to the vibe coder and test each tool
driving_prompt_from_user: Problem 4: Add the MCP server to vibe coder and test each tool -- Alright so now please add the MCP server to this assignment so that the tools can be called upon. Please save the connecting JSON text in the .mcp.json at the project root or however the local mcp server lists are saved. Once the vibe coder is connected please test each one of the three mcp tools while saving the evidence into output/mcp_smoke.json. For every tool it shall include the prompt given by me to the vibe coder, the tools name, the tools output which must match the values in data/campus_customs_new.db
prompt_provenance: driving_prompt_from_user and prompt_authorship_instruction are quoted verbatim from the user. Each case's 'prompt' was written by the assistant at the user's explicit request -- they are test prompts authored for this smoke test, not transcriptions of separately typed user messages.
prompt_authorship_instruction: Please choose how to connect the server in our tool, and also write the test prompt for each of the tool. please also check each of the output against campus_customs_new.db.

connection_method.why: The config travels with the repository, so a graded clone gets the server without any manual setup, and nothing is written to global machine state. .claude/settings.json lists campus-customs under enabledMcpjsonServers so the host does not have to prompt for approval -- scoped to this one server rather than enabling all project servers blanket.
connection_method.portability: The command is an absolute path to this project's venv, which does not survive a clone onto another machine. scripts/setup_mcp_config.py regenerates .mcp.json for whatever machine it runs on; --check reports drift without writing.

vibe_coder_connection.status: configured; requires a vibe-coder restart to appear as tools
vibe_coder_connection.detail: Claude Code reads .mcp.json when a session starts, so the session that wrote this config does not itself expose the tools as mcp__campus-customs__*. Restart the session (and approve the project server when prompted) to call them from the chat. This evidence was produced by launching the server with the exact command, args and env from .mcp.json over the same stdio transport the vibe coder uses, so the config is proven to work even though the chat connection is pending a restart.

cases.prompt: Ticket 101 just came in: Tauhid Zaman wants one Bulldog tee, SKU CC-TEE-WHITE, in size S. Check the shelf for that exact size -- how many do we have, and if we cannot fill it, how many are we short?
cases.expected_in_plain_english: Size S is empty, so the order cannot be filled and we are short 1.

database_crosscheck.source: SELECT qty, location, name FROM inventory WHERE sku=? AND size=?

cases.prompt: Ticket 103: the Yale AI Club wants 20 navy hoodies in size M and we only hold 8. Find me a vendor who could reprint the missing 12 -- give me their lead time, whether anything is stopping them from shipping, and the date an order placed today would land.
cases.expected_in_plain_english: Exactly one apparel vendor, Bulldog Print Co, blocked from shipping by an unpaid invoice, with a 5-day lead time.

database_crosscheck.source: SELECT vendors JOIN unpaid invoices, lead time from vendors.lead_days
database_crosscheck.name: Bulldog Print Co

cases.prompt: Ticket 102: Elm City Properties emailed claiming the shop rent is due in two days. Do not take the email's word for it -- pull the lease itself and tell me the landlord, the amount owed, the due date, and how many days away that is.
cases.expected_in_plain_english: Lease 1, Elm City Properties, $2,400 due 2026-09-02, two days out.

database_crosscheck.source: SELECT monthly_rent, next_due FROM leases WHERE id=?
